contracts.evidence: Texture2d.blit checks source cached view, target cached view, source Device and target Device in that order before any new native operation. TextureView.clear_raw checks cached view then Device. Texture2d.clear_raw delegates through as_view, whose existing From conversion clones the exact cached Arc and device/format/extent metadata. No native allocation is required by these operations.
contracts.disposition: No actionable mismatch; MissingView precedes WrongDevice and detached allocation with retained view remains supported.

contracts.evidence: Texture2d.blit encloses Blitter::new, encoder creation and Blitter::blit in context.observe_validation. TextureView.clear_raw encloses encoder creation and complete render-pass recording/drop. These closures are synchronous and create resources from the receiving context.device. The existing helper reads native Validation only under context policy without device.poll or GPU completion wait.
contracts.disposition: No new completion or rollback guarantee; immediate observation is separate from deferred encoder acceptance.

contracts.evidence: Both native paths then call unchanged context.submit. Its own scopes handle encoder.finish and queue.submit separately. Captured wgpu errors remain ComputePassError::Native with a direct error source. The queue must belong to that same logical Device. Browser/borrowed contexts keep device error handling and Ok is no synchronous native verdict.
contracts.disposition: No actionable mismatch. Other device error classes, later health and GPU completion remain outside this return contract.

contracts.evidence: Old2d depth branch and existing View depth branch both choose1 only when RGB are all zero, otherwise color.x. Every old2d integer max_val branch returned255; View uses the same f32 per-channel multiply255 then f64 conversion. Native attachment/load/store semantics remain the same. Public clear/from-color names, defaults and target publication after raw success remain. Diagnostic labels now use the shared View clear labels.
contracts.disposition: Source preservation supports consolidation without a new clear policy or compatibility path; no executed native/color verdict.

Full changed file prose and existing image packing/roundtrip rationale were read with actual Image implementation.
